title: You Build a House From the Ground Down
premise: Leo sets a cardboard box on bare dirt, and the narrator tells you it is already a house. Rain turns the floor to mud, so you add a pier foundation. A heavy corner sinks, so you add spread footings. Frost lifts the house, so you dig below the frost line. You dug that deep anyway, so the hole becomes a basement, but it seeps, so you add a footing drain. A storm floods the basement anyway.
